nodes.label: India's Vegetation Types
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Five major types based on rainfall and climate: Tropical Evergreen, Tropical Deciduous (Moist and Dry), Tropical Thorn, Montane, Mangrove. Relief, soil, temperature and photoperiod also determine vegetation.

nodes.label: Social Forestry and Vanamahotsav
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Programmes to increase forest cover and awareness. Vanamahotsav (tree planting festival). Social forestry involves community in conservation. Government targets 33% forest cover.

nodes.label: Community and Sacred Groves
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Communities protect forests through traditional practices. Sacred groves (Devvans) preserved by tribals. Examples in Rajasthan (Bishnoi community protecting khejri and wildlife), Meghalaya, Madhya Pradesh.
